# mux_live_stream (Resource)

A live stream: a long-lived ingest endpoint an encoder broadcasts to with the stream key. Meant for streams that are part of the configuration, such as a channel that is always there; streams an application creates per event belong to the application. Playback IDs and simulcast targets are resources of their own (`mux_live_stream_playback_id`, `mux_live_stream_simulcast_target`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mux_live_stream" "channel" {
  title        = "Main channel"
  latency_mode = "standard"

  # What Mux records of each broadcast.
  new_asset_settings = {
    playback_policies = ["public"]
    static_renditions = ["highest"]
  }

  generated_subtitles = [{
    name                         = "English (generated)"
    language_code                = "en"
    transcription_vocabulary_ids = [mux_transcription_vocabulary.products.id]
  }]
}

resource "mux_transcription_vocabulary" "products" {
  phrases = ["Mux", "OpenTofu"]
}

# What the encoder needs: rtmps://global-live.mux.com:443/app and this key.
output "stream_key" {
  value     = mux_live_stream.channel.stream_key
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `audio_only` (Boolean) Whether Mux drops the video track and processes only audio. Defaults to `false`. Mux ignores a change to it, so changing it replaces the live stream.
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Refuse to delete or replace this object. Defaults to `true`, because a new live stream gets a new ID, stream key and playback IDs, so every encoder and player would have to be reconfigured. Apply `false` before destroying it.
- `embedded_subtitles` (Attributes List) Closed captions embedded in the incoming stream (CEA-608) to pass on. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--embedded_subtitles))
- `generated_subtitles` (Attributes List) Subtitles generated by speech recognition. Mux allows one track. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--generated_subtitles))
- `latency_mode` (String) Latency of the stream: `standard`, `reduced` or `low`. Defaults to `standard`. Mux does not allow subtitles on a `low` latency stream.
- `max_continuous_duration` (Number) Seconds a broadcast may last before Mux disconnects it, from 60 to 43200. Mux defaults it to 43200 (12 hours), and to 300 for a `test` stream.
- `new_asset_settings` (Attributes) Settings of the assets Mux records from the stream. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--new_asset_settings))
- `passthrough` (String) Arbitrary metadata, at most 255 characters. It is copied to the assets recorded from the stream and included in webhooks.
- `reconnect_slate_url` (String) URL of an image to show as slate media instead of Mux's default.
- `reconnect_window` (Number) Seconds Mux waits for a disconnected encoder to come back before it ends the recording, from 0 to 1800. Mux defaults it to 60.
- `test` (Boolean) Whether this is a test live stream: free, watermarked and limited to five minutes per broadcast. Defaults to `false`. Changing it replaces the live stream.
- `title` (String) Title of the live stream (`meta.title`), at most 512 characters. Players may show it, so it must not hold anything sensitive.
- `use_slate_for_standard_latency` (Boolean) Whether to insert slate media while a `standard` latency stream waits for its encoder to reconnect. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the live stream was created, in seconds since the Unix epoch.
- `id` (String) Live stream ID.
- `srt_passphrase` (String, Sensitive) Passphrase for encrypting a broadcast over SRT. It is stored in the state.
- `stream_key` (String, Sensitive) Key an encoder broadcasts with over RTMP. Whoever has it can broadcast to the stream. It is stored in the state.

<a id="nestedatt--embedded_subtitles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `embedded_subtitles`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the caption track.

Optional:

- `language_channel` (String) CEA-608 channel to read: `cc1` to `cc4`. Defaults to `cc1`.
- `language_code` (String) Language of the captions, as a BCP 47 code. Defaults to `en`.
- `passthrough` (String) Arbitrary metadata for the track, at most 255 characters.


<a id="nestedatt--generated_subtitles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `generated_subtitles`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the subtitle track.

Optional:

- `language_code` (String) Language of the audio: `en`, `en-US`, `es`, `fr`, `de`, `pt` or `it`. Defaults to `en`.
- `passthrough` (String) Arbitrary metadata for the track, at most 255 characters.
- `transcription_vocabulary_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the transcription vocabularies (`mux_transcription_vocabulary`) to use.


<a id="nestedatt--new_asset_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `new_asset_settings`

Optional:

- `playback_policies` (Set of String) Playback policies of each recorded asset: `public`, `signed`. Mux does not let them change, so changing them replaces the live stream.
- `static_renditions` (Set of String) Resolutions of the static renditions (MP4 or M4A files) to make of each recorded asset: `highest`, `audio-only`, `2160p`, `1440p`, `1080p`, `720p`, `540p`, `480p`, `360p`, `270p`.
- `video_quality` (String) Video quality of each recorded asset: `plus` or `premium`. When unset, the environment's default applies.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by live stream ID.
terraform import mux_live_stream.channel ZEBrNTpHC02iUah025KM3te6ylM7W4S4silsrFtUkn3Ag
```
